title: FindingNemo Extraction 1: Phenol-based Method
author: Inswasti Cahyani
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxgnpjve
materials: Add 550 μl buffer-saturated phenol to each tube containing lysate.
Add 250 μl buffer-saturated phenol and 250 μl chloroform-isoamyl alcohol to each tube. Repeat step 11-12 and continue to step 15. go to step #11 go to step #12

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Pellet 5 × 10⁶ cells in a 2 mL tube by centrifuging at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash cell pellet
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL cold PBS, centrifuge at 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet thoroughly by pipette mixing in 20 µL cold PBS.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL TLB‑SDS and 100 µg RNase A (1 µL), then vortex at 2000 rpm for 5 seconds.

steps.title: RNase incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour, mixing by inversion every 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 200 µg Proteinase K (10 µL) and mix by slow inversion 5 times.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate at 50 °C for 2 hours, mixing by slow inversion 3 times (once every 30 minutes).

steps.title: Split lysate
steps.instruction: Divide the lysate into two phase‑lock gel tubes (~550 µL per tube).

steps.title: Emulsify on rotator
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a HulaMixer or vertical rotator at 20 rpm for 10 minutes; if a fine emulsion has not formed after 1 minute, gradually increase the speed.

steps.title: Centrifuge phase‑lock tubes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4500 rpm for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh phase‑lock gel tube using a wide‑bore P1000 tip (pour or pipette).

steps.title: Combine aqueous phases
steps.instruction: Combine the transferred aqueous phase(s) into a 2 mL tube (final volume ≈1 mL).

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol, mix gently, centrifuge at 4500 rpm for 10 minutes (room temperature), then transfer the aqueous phase to a new phase‑lock gel tube; repeat this chloroform‑centrifuge‑transfer cycle once more before proceeding.

steps.title: Transfer to conical tube
steps.instruction: Using a wide‑bore P1000 tip, transfer the aqueous phase to a 5 mL conical tube, avoiding any material from the chloroform interface.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 0.4 × volume of 5 M ammonium acetate (≈400 µL) and mix by slow inversion.

steps.title: Add glass beads
steps.instruction: Add 3 clean glass beads to the tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL absolute ethanol and mix gently.

steps.title: Bind DNA to beads
steps.instruction: Rotate the tube on a vertical rotator at 9 rpm for 5 minutes; if no rotator is available, invert the tube 30–40 times (≈5–6 seconds per inversion).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the liquid without disturbing the DNA‑bound glass beads.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with 1 mL 70 % ethanol, invert the tube 2–3 times, then discard the ethanol.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the 70 % ethanol wash described in the previous step.

steps.title: Remove residual wash
steps.instruction: Insert a bead retainer into a collection tube, pour the beads into the retainer, and spin for ~1 second in a mini‑centrifuge (or the shortest possible time) to remove residual wash buffer; keep the bead retainer.

steps.title: Elute DNA (first)
steps.instruction: Transfer the beads to a new 2 mL low‑bind tube, add 250 µL elution buffer immediately (do not let beads dry; alternatively pre‑aliquot the buffer), then incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes, gently aspirating and dispensing the eluate over the beads with a wide‑bore P1000 tip at regular intervals.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Insert the bead retainer into a clean 2 mL low‑bind tube, pour the beads from the previous step, and centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute DNA (second)
steps.instruction: Add another 510 µL elution buffer to the eluate, mix with a wide‑bore P1000 tip, and leave overnight at room temperature; pipette thoroughly with a wide‑bore tip before downstream use to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Store or proceed
steps.instruction: Store the DNA at 4 °C or continue directly to ultra‑long library preparation (modified ONT ULK001 protocol). If only SQK‑RAD004 is available, follow the modified RAD004 or KrazyStarFish (KSF) library protocols.

steps.title: Quantify and assess DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA according to the “UHMW DNA QC” procedure and calculate %CV to assess homogeneity; if the DNA is insufficiently homogeneous, incubate longer before use.
